annotations.title: Write robots.txt rules for AI crawlers

description: Write robots.txt lines for AI crawlers: start from a preset (allow every AI crawler, block training only, or block them all), override any crawler by its user-agent token, add paths to keep every crawler out of, a sitemap and Content Signals (search, ai-input, ai-train). Answers the file's text, which crawlers it blocks and allows, and any input it ignored with why. Nothing is fetched or stored; Googlebot and Bingbot are never named, so search indexing is unchanged.

contentSignals.description: Content Signals to state; leave out for none.

crawlers.description: Per-crawler choices over the preset, by user-agent token: { "GPTBot": "block", "OAI-SearchBot": "allow" }.

disallowPaths.description: Paths every crawler stays out of, each starting with "/" ("/admin").

preset.description: Where to start: "allow_all" (the default), "block_training" (block crawlers that collect for AI training, keep AI search) or "block_all".

sitemapUrl.description: The sitemap's absolute https:// address, written last.

name: generate_ai_robots_txt
